thread:
Ana M: ran quick onboarding sweep for pegasus-mini-12b across three quant levels (fp16, int6, int5). sharing cost/quality tradeoffs and proposed rollout for consumer chat + GTN. summary at the end.

Ravi S: numbers plz.

Ana M: condensed: 
- fp16 (anchor): p95 latency 210ms, cost/1k tokens $1.12, baseline quality = 0.0%
- int6: p95 175ms, cost/1k tokens $0.66 (~41% savings), avg QA delta -0.9%, longform -1.1%
- int5: p95 160ms, cost/1k tokens $0.48 (~57% savings), avg QA delta -1.9%, longform -3.6%
- mix: 70% short queries, 20% multi-turn, 10% retrieval/longform
- notes: int5 shows hallucination spikes in retrieval slice, especially multi-hop factual chains.

Priya D: for GTN, product cares about perceived latency and noticeable answer correctness drops. int6 looks in sweet spot. Any human-eval breakdown?

Ana M: human eval on 400 stratified samples: int6 indistinguishable in 92% of cases, int5 78%. Fail clusters for int6: citations/URLs, date-sensitive facts. Automated signals: 
```
- QA-exact-match: int6 -0.8%, int5 -2.4%
- MRR rerank: int6 -0.5%, int5 -1.8%
- hallucination-rate (heuristic): int6 +0.3pp, int5 +1.6pp
```

Marco L: infra note: int5 memory is denser; saw 4% more allocator churn on some machines, but no OOM yet. p50 improved by ~10ms.

OpsBot: synthetic-regression-suite (5k queries) completed. int6 pass 97.9% (anchor 99.1%), int5 pass 95.2%. No SLO breaches.

Ravi S: propose routing policy: default -> int6 for consumer free tier, int5 gated (opt-in experimental) for microburst short-chat, enterprise default -> fp16. Also add length and retrieval flags. Pseudoconfig: 
```
rules:
  - if tier == "enterprise" or slice == "retrieval": variant: fp16
  - elif prompt_type == "short-burst" and feature_flag("int5_experiment"):
       variant: int5
  - else: variant: int6
canary: {int6: 3%, fp16: 97%}
```

Priya D: GTN comms should highlight ~40% cost reduction vs fp16 and sub-1% measured QA drop for int6. Add rollback plan and top-5 regressions.

Ana M: suggested rollout checklist: 1) 72h canary @3% with per-slice monitors 2) synthetic replay on top-10 customers 3) ramp to 25% over 3 days if clean 4) 30d post-ramp quality evaluation window. Add auto-rollback triggers.

Marco L: auto-rollback triggers I'd add: 
- QA-exact-match delta >1.2% on monitored slices
- hallucination-rate +0.8pp absolute
- complaint_rate +0.25pp
Also enable kv-prefix caching for short-burst to reduce token cost.

Ravi S: scoreboard fields for PR: unit-cost table, p95/p50 latency, human-eval indistinguishability %, QA-exact-match delta, rerank MRR delta, top-10 failure examples, infra churn metrics, rollback criteria. Thresholds: fail if human-eval indistinguishable <90% or QA delta >1.2%.

Priya D: ok to ship int6 as default for consumer (opt-out). Keep fp16 for enterprise & retrieval-heavy. int5 only behind explicit opt-in + clear warning label. Need customer-facing note for GTN: "Were switching to a faster, lower-cost variant for typical chat; enterprise-grade routes unchanged." Add link to rollback policy.

Ana M: will open PR with attached scorecard and raw slices. I'll include a focused sample of 8 regression examples for product review. Drafting the GTN blurb now.

Marco L: please add a canary dashboard with top-10 monitored customers and an ops-runbook.

Ana M: will tag infra and product when PR ready. outcome: recommend int6 default for consumer chat (opt-out), fp16 for enterprise/retrieval, int5 experimental opt-in behind flag.
